description:
Cold room solenoid valves are electromechanical devices used to control the flow of refrigerant in refrigeration and air conditioning systems. At CoolMass Refrigeration, we supply high-quality solenoid valves that help ensure precise temperature regulation and system efficiency across a wide range of cold room applications.

Our solenoid valves operate automatically in response to system signals, opening or closing the refrigerant path based on demand. This control prevents unwanted refrigerant flow when the system is off, reduces energy consumption, and protects the compressor from flooding or backflow. Compatible with refrigerants such as R134a, R404A, R407C, R410A, and R507, these valves are suitable for both high- and low-pressure refrigeration lines.

Built with corrosion-resistant materials and durable coils, our valves are designed for long service life in harsh environments. They are available in multiple port sizes, voltages, and configurations—suitable for use in both new installations and system retrofits. Whether you’re working with freezer rooms, food storage units, or HVAC chillers, solenoid valves play a crucial role in ensuring safe, efficient, and automated system performance.

description:
